knownLimitations: UPU currently lists Bolivia as not requiring postcodes; no placeholder code or surface can be introduced to satisfy M2.
AGBC publishes tracking, P.O. Box and office context but no postcode assignment or geometry dataset and no open postal data licence.
The generic M0 BO address-format placeholder is not postal authority and cannot enable a real route.
The ArcGIS Polygon candidate uses Colombia CRS EPSG:3116 and is geographically outside Bolivia with empty licence metadata.
